name: Microsoft 365
summary: Your Outlook calendar, mail and contacts, read for you; anything sent asks first.

requires.why: To talk to Microsoft: login.microsoftonline.com, graph.microsoft.com.

settings.label: Application (client) ID
settings.hint: From your own app registration in Microsoft Entra, with public client flows allowed. The plugin's README walks you through making one; it is free.

settings.label: Tenant
settings.hint: "common" works for personal and school or work accounts. A school or company may need its own domain or tenant ID here.

settings.label: Connect Microsoft
settings.hint: Shows a short code and the page to enter it on, here and in the chat. Sign in there with the account to connect.

settings.label: Microsoft sign-in
settings.hint: Written by the plugin when you connect. Kept in this computer's keychain.
